articles.summary: Invitation Homes Inc. (NYSE: INVH) (“Invitation Homes,” the “Company,” or "our"), the nation's premier single-family home leasing and management company, will release third quarter 2026 financial and operating results on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, after the market closes. The Company will host a live webcast on Thursday, October 29, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. Eastern Time to review third quarter results, discuss recent events, and conduct a question-and-answer session with covering sell-side research analysts. A link to the live webcast will be available online from our investor relations website at www.invh.com , with a replay available for one year. About Invitation Homes: Invitation Homes, an SP 500 company, is the nation’s premier single-family home leasing and management company, helping to expand housing through new development and strategic partnerships.
